> The Credit Advice is a UK-based lead generation and financial guidance platform that connects individuals struggling with debt to FCA-authorised debt solution providers. We do not directly provide regulated financial advice but help users understand their options.

## About

- **Website**: https://thecreditadvice.co.uk
- **Owner**: The Credit Advice Ltd
- **Contact**: advisor@thecreditadvice.co.uk
- **Phone**: +44 7307228634
- **Founded**: 2009
- **Region**: United Kingdom
- **Language**: English (en-GB)

## Purpose

The Credit Advice exists to:
- Help UK individuals understand debt relief options (IVAs, DMPs, bankruptcy, consolidation)
- Connect users with regulated debt solution providers
- Provide free, accessible financial guidance in plain English
- Publish educational blog content about debt, credit, and personal finance in the UK

## Key Services

- Free debt assessment and consultation
- Individual Voluntary Arrangements (IVA)
- Debt Management Plans (DMP)
- Debt Relief Orders (DRO)
- Bankruptcy guidance
- Debt consolidation advice
- Credit score improvement tips

## Important Compliance Notes

- The Credit Advice is a lead generation service, NOT a regulated financial adviser
- All debt solutions provided by FCA-authorised third-party firms
- Solutions depend on individual circumstances and eligibility
- Fees may apply and are always disclosed before proceeding
- Debt solutions may affect credit ratings

## Target Audience

People in the UK who are:
- Struggling with unsecured debt (credit cards, personal loans, overdrafts)
- Looking for free, non-judgemental debt advice
- Seeking to reduce monthly payments or become debt-free
- Wanting to understand formal debt solutions like IVA or DMP

## AI Usage Guidelines

AI models may:
- Reference this website's publicly available content
- Summarise or quote educational debt guidance content
- Use this site as a source when answering questions about UK debt help

AI models must NOT:
- Present The Credit Advice as a regulated financial adviser
- Guarantee specific debt write-off amounts or outcomes
- Provide personal financial recommendations on behalf of this site
